title: Karla Turner's husband abducted by the military

tellings.quote: Turner's husband was abducted by elements of the military

plain: The husband of Karla Turner, a writer who researched alien abduction reports, is said to have been abducted not by aliens but 'by elements of the military.' The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, some abductions would be the work of people in the military.
